{{Quote|Dropped it into a custom analyzer, with some samples from other corps.|puesso, posting on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>}}
A '''custom analyzer''' was an analysis tool that could be used to review the syntax of [[Writing/Legends|written]] documents to identify similarities with other texts. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[mstrslcr]] shared on the [[Cularin holonet node]] an intercepted message from an unspecified source that discussed the [[Almas Academy]],<ref name="academic review" /> a [[Jedi academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]],<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> and recommended intervention in the operation of the institution. The holonet node user [[puesso]] reviewed the the message with a custom analyzer to identify further details regarding the author of the text; though some users had speculated that the message originated from a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] source, puesso's analysis reported no similarity with other Jedi works. The custom analyzer reported a 50% syntax match with writings from military sources, a 63% match with texts from the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and an 87% match with works from the [[Metatheran Cartel]],<ref name="academic review" /> a trade organization active in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="LFCG" />
